svg.text: One design-time control point for every Microsoft agent platform: governance, security, cost and compliance. Read-only, no deployed traffic, no token spend, and it runs before the agent is registered.
Trusted MCP servers, tool overrides, prices.
Every rule cites a CAF or
Priced from the definition, including fan-out through delegation.
In tokens today, in money once the policy carries prices.
Connected agents in Foundry. Only the calls no rule can make.
May not contradict a deterministic finding.
Ingested natively by GitHub code scanning, so findings
land in the pull request as annotations.
Renders template v1.0. Every field traces to a BOM
field or a rule result. Nothing is invented.
Template v1.0 built · packs on the roadmap
One per agent, kept as a CI artifact.
Underivable fields print as "requires human input".
Certifies a BOM hash. Any composition change voids it
automatically, so an old approval cannot cover a new agent.
GitHub Action: tests, scan, SARIF to code scanning, dossiers kept as an artifact. Verified with a control that must pass and one that must fail.
A baseline accepts existing findings. A new critical finding, or an MCP manifest that no longer matches its pin, fails the pull request.
